cuda.change: Same paired Hadamard/fused device kernels as v1; isolate fused packed host dispatch to avoid unused generic pointers/grid setup
cuda.correctness: Independent float32 butterfly then FP16/BF16 rounding and INT4 oracle, selected finite component encodings, both transform scales, scalar-offset storage/guards, legacy validation, changing-input stream/graph with negative controls
cuda.primary_metric: Same-buffer warmed 64-node CUDA graph device events, ten replays; three timing rounds in one process, alternating old/new group order, scale=1; not cold calls or cache-exceeding workloads
cuda.secondary_metric: Ordinary allocating/out calls at 256 threads; synchronization brackets each timed sample; 5000 calls per group; no >5% case regressions
cuda.controls: Small packed transform/fused, N1, original transform/fused N8/256, packed quantization N2/16 and original quantization N8

environment.cpu_affinity: First allowed CPU recorded and pinned
environment.device: Reuse RTX4090 if available; record actual hardware, never mix comparison ratios from different GPU models

aa_control: Three same-control-function pairs per round; every ratio between 1/1.05 and 1.05
nine: Reuse v1 results on unchanged published 0706213: 15 GPU differential cases and 108 semantic tests. This CUDA-only confirmation does not rerun NineToothed.
publication: Only accepted implementation goes to existing feature branch; preserve rejected candidates and all raw data on evidence branches; Chinese commits; no merging
shutdown: Export results and source/protocol hashes; verify local backups before powering off the instance
additional_correctness: Repeat 512 finite-input overflow/cancellation/guard compatibility cases before timing. Do not interpret nonfinite intermediate quantization as a mathematical INT4 guarantee.
